title: A TFT-like autobattler that takes place in pre-apocalyptic Tokyo. First impressions?
author: MjrDutchSchaefer
selftext:
I'm building an isometric TFT-like autobattler with 90's anime aesthetics. You build your squad around your commander and hit massive power spikes by choosing the right items, units, and passive effects throughout a run.

I'm really interested in hearing your first impressions on the teaser trailer. 

* Does the trailer do a good job of informing you on what kind of game it is?
* What do you think of the style? Is the 90's anime aesthetic coming through at all?
* Does the combat read as too hectic or difficult to understand? Are the units readable?

Please don't spare my feelings in your feedback; your comments are a gift. Thanks for your time!
